## HueMux v0.0.4-alpha.15 — Tile polish: tinted state, gradient sliders, button order

> **Alpha.** The aggregate tiles get their finishing pass: active buttons
> inherit the lamp's color, the tiles' sliders fill with a gradient of every
> active light, color and favorite swap places, preset stars take the scene's
> tint with the tile-style hover fill, and the all-lights title is back.

### Tiles across the board

The icon-only button treatment applies to both tiles (the room tile was
already covered — the visible difference was the white active state), and the
active button now inherits the tile's representative lamp color instead of
staying white. The lamp-type icon in every card's header — and the tile's
bulb — is tinted the same way.

### Tile sliders fill with a color gradient

The all-lights and per-room sliders now paint their filled portion with a
gradient of every active light's color (up to five, matching the tile's
colour wash), trailing into the track. It follows the finger while dragging.

### Button order and preset stars

On both tiles the color button now comes first, then favorite, then power —
the two stateful buttons sit together on the right, away from the
mis-tap-prone color swatch. The preset favorite star gets the same soft-fill
hover as the tile buttons and its active state is tinted with the scene's own
color.

### The all-lights title is back

"All lights" returns to the top tile — the icon-only experiment left it bare.
The per-room tile stays icon-only inside its named room card.
